sampling: 25 possessions with >= 4 events drawn at random (seed 42) from the TEST-split matches of data/processed/possession_sequences.parquet

thresholds.rule: score quantile on VALIDATION snapshots whose predicted-positive rate equals validation prevalence

notes: eventtime_* columns come from the in-play event-time models: step t uses events 0..t only; scores are defined while no shot / box entry (incl. a possessing-team pass ending in the box) has occurred.
first_danger_event_idx is the first shot / box-entry event (NaN if none); lead_events = first_danger_event_idx - first alert.
RETROSPECTIVE_* columns are full-possession models retrained on the frame-corrected labels; they see the whole possession and are NOT early predictions.
The fraction-based v3 columns (xgb_start_prob, xgb_50pct_prob, xgb_75pct_prob) were withdrawn: the prefix length encodes the possession length.
